data_objects.name: cyclone_track_scene_metadata
data_objects.meaning: A row-wise table of time-stamped tracked-event metadata, including location and intensity-related fields, categorical or indicator fields, image-mask summaries, an event identifier, and a relative path to an associated HDF5 scene.

data_objects.name: infrared_brightness_temperature_scenes
data_objects.meaning: A directory-partitioned collection of HDF5 scenes. Each representative file contains one 512 by 512 Float64 dataset named Infrared whose embedded metadata identifies it as brightness temperature in kelvin.

variables.name: year
variables.meaning: Four-digit year component of the row timestamp and linked scene filename timestamp.

variables.name: month
variables.meaning: Month component of the row timestamp.

variables.name: day
variables.meaning: Day-of-month component of the row timestamp.

variables.name: hour
variables.meaning: Hour component of the row timestamp, encoded from 0 through 23.

variables.name: grade
variables.meaning: Integer categorical grade assigned to the tracked event at the row timestamp; the public artifacts do not define the code labels.

variables.name: lat
variables.meaning: Latitude coordinate of the tracked-event location at the row timestamp.

variables.name: lng
variables.meaning: Longitude coordinate of the tracked-event location at the row timestamp; observed values extend above 180, so the encoding is not confined to the -180 to 180 interval.

variables.name: pressure
variables.meaning: Pressure measurement associated with the tracked event at the row timestamp; its pressure reference and unit are not stated.

variables.name: wind
variables.meaning: Wind measurement associated with the tracked event at the row timestamp; its averaging convention and unit are not stated.

variables.name: dir50
variables.meaning: Direction-or-code field in the 50-labeled field triplet; it is constant at 9 in the public table and its code meaning is not defined.

variables.name: long50
variables.meaning: Long-axis-like field in the 50-labeled triplet; it is zero throughout the public table and its meaning and unit are not defined.

variables.name: short50
variables.meaning: Short-axis-like field in the 50-labeled triplet; it is zero throughout the public table and its meaning and unit are not defined.

variables.name: dir30
variables.meaning: Direction-or-code field in the 30-labeled field triplet; it is constant at 9 in the public table and its code meaning is not defined.

variables.name: long30
variables.meaning: Long-axis-like field in the 30-labeled triplet; it is zero throughout the public table and its meaning and unit are not defined.

variables.name: short30
variables.meaning: Short-axis-like field in the 30-labeled triplet; it is zero throughout the public table and its meaning and unit are not defined.

variables.name: landfall
variables.meaning: Indicator-like field labeled landfall; it is zero throughout the public table, so its positive encoding is not exhibited.

variables.name: intp
variables.meaning: Binary interpolation indicator for the time-stamped track row, encoded as 0 or 1.

variables.name: mask
variables.meaning: Scene mask count. In representative rows with a nonzero value, it equals the number of linked Infrared pixels encoded exactly as 130.

variables.name: mask_pct
variables.meaning: Masked-pixel fraction for the linked 512 by 512 scene. Despite the pct suffix, observed values equal mask divided by 262144 and are encoded on a 0-to-1 scale rather than a 0-to-100 scale.

variables.name: id
variables.meaning: Tracked-event identifier that also names the first-level image directory partition; it is an identifier rather than a calendar field despite its numeric form.

variables.name: hdf_full_path
variables.meaning: Relative path intended to link the metadata row to its event- and timestamp-specific HDF5 scene under the public image directory.

variables.name: Infrared
variables.meaning: Single-band 512 by 512 Float64 brightness-temperature array stored in each representative HDF5 scene.

variables.name: pixel row index
variables.meaning: First displayed raster axis with 512 pixel positions; no geographic direction or coordinate values are embedded in the inspected scene metadata.

variables.name: pixel column index
variables.meaning: Second displayed raster axis with 512 pixel positions; no geographic direction or coordinate values are embedded in the inspected scene metadata.

structure.description: Metadata rows are repeated scene-time observations grouped by id. The year, month, day, and hour fields form an hour-resolved timestamp, while intp distinguishes rows marked as interpolated from other rows.

The HDF5 collection is partitioned into directories named by id. Scene filenames combine a YYYYMMDDHH timestamp, the same id, an HMW8 or HMW9 token, and a trailing channel/version-like token; representative files contain exactly one Infrared raster.

hdf_full_path is the explicit row-to-scene alignment key and is unique across metadata rows. Public image coverage is partial: some table paths refer to event partitions that are absent from the public image directory, so a populated path does not guarantee an available counterpart.

Each available scene has two 512-position pixel axes and one Float64 Infrared measurement per pixel. The HDF5 metadata exposes brightness-temperature name and unit but no CRS, geotransform, latitude/longitude arrays, or declared NoData value through the available raster reader.

For representative nonzero-mask scenes, mask counts pixels equal to 130 and mask_pct records that count divided by the full 512 by 512 pixel count; scenes with mask equal to zero need not contain that exact value.

uncertainties: The timestamp timezone, time standard, and whether a scene is instantaneous or represents an interval are not stated.
The grade codebook, pressure unit and reference, wind unit and averaging convention, and the intended semantics of the 30- and 50-labeled triplets are not defined by the public artifacts.

The coordinate datum and explicit latitude/longitude units are not provided. The scene files expose only pixel coordinates, so the relationship between each raster footprint or center and the row latitude/longitude cannot be established.

The value 130 behaves like a mask or fill sentinel in representative scenes, but the inspected HDF5 metadata does not declare it as NoData; its exact status outside the observed mask relationship remains ambiguous.
The HMW8 and HMW9 filename tokens distinguish scene subsets, but their full platform or processing-level meanings are not expanded in the public artifacts.
The metadata table includes more row paths and event identifiers than are represented by available HDF5 files, and complete counterpart coverage cannot be assumed.
annotation_notes: The annotation was derived from the complete CSV schema and bounded representative inspection of HDF5 scenes spanning the observed filename variants.
Embedded HDF5 attributes establish that Infrared is brightness temperature in kelvin; other physical units were left null where the public artifacts provide no unit metadata.
Only the declared public root and the specified dataset-perception and earth-observation treatment references were used.
